label: late-episode D1 after the previous trial reached S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only late in the episode: no activity before trial ~75, 85% of mass in trials 90-99, low model value (<7.1 at every active step). Within late D1 it is gated by the previous trial having reached S2 (dev P 0.43, R 0.78, mass recall 0.87). Magnitude/precision is highest after a rare a1->S2 transition (late D1 & prev a1 & prev S2: precision 0.97, 63% of mass on 42% of active steps); after a common a2->S2 trial it fires more weakly and mostly when that trial was unrewarded. Adding (prev_action==1 | prev_reward==0) raises F1 only to 0.61, so the simpler predicate is recorded. Weak or absent after trials that reached S1. Uses only observed variables (previous state, previous action, previous reward, trial position).
